_meta.note: Whirlpool-group IDENTIFIER LAYER (WM+DW): observed model/12NC -> platform lineage -> scheme. Second positive validation of the reusable identifier architecture (after Electrolux PNC). The 12NC PREFIX encodes platform lineage, which is the deterministic F02 disambiguator. Data-only; not wired into production.

identifierStructure.whirlpoolNative12NC: 12-digit commercial code / 12NC, prefixes 85x (851/853/857/859...) and legacy 481x. Present in OUR catalogue (Whirlpool WM 828, DW 1833). Whirlpool.nl: search by 'typenummer of de 12NC code'.
identifierStructure.hotpointIndesit12NC: 12-digit commercial code starting 8699xxxxxxxx, exposed in official hotpoint.co.uk / indesit.co.uk product URLs & data sheets. NOT in our catalogue (we hold model names + 5-digit spares codes).
identifierStructure.partVsAppliance: Appliance 12NC (85x/481x/8699x) differs from PART 12NC (48xx xxx xxxxx) and Merloni part codes (C00xxxxxx). Do not conflate.
identifierStructure.merloniRefs: Hotpoint/Indesit also use J00xxxxxx model/commercial refs and C00xxxxxx spare-part numbers (Merloni/Indesit Company lineage).
identifierStructure.versionTail: Whirlpool-native 12NC embeds a version tail (e.g. 851000529010/011/012 = base 8510005290 + version).

prefixToLineage.caveat: Prefix->lineage is a STRONG SIGNAL, not proof for every unit; the 12NC is the JOIN KEY to a service doc that states the platform definitively. Post-acquisition exceptions possible.

_meta.ownershipVsLineage: PRESERVED: Hotpoint/Indesit are now corporately under Beko Europe/Arcelik, but their historical code platform is MERLONI (FNN) - do NOT reclassify as ARCELIK_WM_E/H. 12NC/lineage is technical, not corporate.

catalogueCoverage.note: Whirlpool-native 12NCs already in catalogue (self-identifying); Hotpoint/Indesit lack 12NC in catalogue - recover from official product URLs.

mappings.note: Merloni DW: 12NC 8699 prefix confirms Indesit-Company lineage, not Whirlpool-native.

evidence.reference: catalogue-native Whirlpool 12NC; parts API -> Door Switch 481928048008

mappings.note: Whirlpool-native 12NC self-identifying; resolves to parts in our catalogue.

f02Resolution.problem: F02 meaning is platform-dependent (existing whirlpool-group conflict): Merloni FNN vs Whirlpool-native FnEn.
f02Resolution.rule: Resolve F02 by 12NC-prefix lineage, NOT by badge. If only badge is known, return needsPlatform/needsModel.
f02Resolution.honesty: The 12NC prefix is a strong lineage signal; for a definitive per-unit answer the 12NC joins to a service doc stating the platform.
